maddeler.e:
تعتدوا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَدُوا (taʕtadū) /taʕ.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# تُعْتَدَوْا (tuʕtadaw) /tuʕ.ta.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
